Close Access Gaps

Identity and access management, explained simply

settings.editor: Identity and access management controls how users, administrators, devices and applications access your business systems.
Managed identity controls bring together authentication, permissions, access policies, user lifecycle processes, privileged access and regular reviews.
What are they allowed to use?
Under which conditions should access be allowed?
When should access be changed or removed?
Folio3 supports Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and hybrid identity environments.
Identity policies are reviewed alongside your cybersecurity, devices, applications, remote access and compliance needs.
MFA and Conditional Access policies are piloted and validated before wider deployment.
Current directories, applications, licenses, roles and policies are reviewed before any change is recommended.
Managed identity and access management services keep controls up to date through user changes, access reviews, monitoring and policy updates.

settings.title: Manual access management vs. managed identity
Access removed through a defined workflow

settings.editor: Manual access management handles one request at a time. Managed identity keeps the right access in place across the whole user lifecycle.

settings.title: Less access risk with managed identity

settings.editor: Users get only the permissions their current role requires.
MFA and Conditional Access add protection even when a password is stolen.
Privileged accounts get tighter restrictions, monitoring and review.
Accounts, sessions, licenses and application access are removed through a defined process.
Single sign-on and identity groups cut down on unmanaged credentials.
Access records and scheduled reviews give clear evidence of who owns each control.
Document directories, users, roles, applications, authentication methods and current access processes.

Test sign-ins, permissions, application access, exclusions and emergency accounts.
Process user changes, monitor identity health, review access and update policies.
